Priya Desai: FYI for July close  there's a cross-currency vendor passthrough and an experiment-driven credit that both affect revenue recognition. Need quick ruling on accrual vs deferral and FX treatment. Summary sheet: https://tiny.redwood/close/2164
Miguel Torres: Details? vendor passthrough is EUR passthrough billed to customers in EUR but we collect in USD, right?
Priya Desai: Exactly. One customer (GeoNav) used hosted API in July. Usage earned in July but their invoice will be generated in EUR with invoice date 8/02 due to billing cycle. Gross estimated revenue (USD) = 62,150. Experiment credits flagged EXP-JUL-05 = 6,750 (USD equivalent). Also vendor cost recorded in EUR; potential FX remeasurement on liability.
Dana Walker: From revrec: service delivered in July -> accrue revenue. For the vendor pass-through, if we're the principal, we recognize gross revenue and cost; if agent, record net. What's the contract?
Priya Desai: Contract shows we act as principal for GeoNav (we bill and collect). So gross accrual appropriate. FX: use month-end spot (7/31) for liability remeasurement; any FX P&L should hit other income/expense, not revenue.
Miguel Torres: Ran numbers from logs. Draft JE (gross):
```
DR 1300 Unbilled AR 62,150
CR 4000 Revenue - Usage 62,150
Memo: Accrual for GeoNav July usage (gross, principal)
```
Miguel Torres: Applying experiment credits net now per policy (credits applied at invoicing and tied to EXP-JUL-05). Proposed net JE:
```
DR 1300 Unbilled AR 55,400
CR 4000 Revenue - Usage 55,400
Memo: Net accrual after expected experiment credits EXP-JUL-05
```
Priya Desai: Also captured vendor passthrough cost (EUR 4,900) and FX remeasurement note in backup. I'll attach per-customer breakout, experiment export, and FX rate screenshot.
revrec-bot: Uploads: exp_export_EXP-JUL-05.csv (received 2164510200), fx_rates_20260731.png (received 2164510300).
Dana Walker: Confirming policy: netting expected credits is fine since they are programmatic and predictable. Because net accrual > $50k, route to CFO for sign-off.
Priya Desai: @CFO_Jess tagging for approval. All backup is in the sheet: https://tiny.redwood/close/2164#gid=3
CFO_Jess: Reviewed. Approve net accrual treatment and FX approach. Please include a one-line auditor disclosure: "Revenue recognized in July for services delivered; experiment credits expected to reduce billed revenue; FX remeasurement recorded to Other Income/Expense." Post the NetSuite JE tomorrow AM for $55,400 and tag close-pack PR #427.
Miguel Torres: Will post tomorrow and attach JE export. Dana will add the auditor note to the close pack.
Priya Desai: Thanks team, closing this thread.
__notes: Slack thread about July month-end: accrual for unbilled customer usage with cross-currency vendor passthrough and pricing-experiment credits. Includes JE code blocks, uploads by bot, FX note, and CFO approval.
